create_argument_parser: create an ArgumentParser instance that sets up eval parameters for model evaluation
parse_eval_args: parse command line arguments for evaluation including batch size and GPU IDs
add_eval_parameters: add evaluation parameters like test folder, ground truth folder, and dataset to the parser
parse_arg_string: parse a string of arguments and return args and grouped argument dictionaries
configure_eval_options: configure eval options including num views, render IDs, and auto regressive mode
